fields.label: VEHICLE
fields.value: Space Shuttle Challenger (OV-099), 10th flight; SRB set BI-026, External Tank ET-26 (LWT-19)

fields.label: RECOVERY
fields.value: None. Orbiter destroyed 73 seconds after liftoff; debris salvaged at sea by U.S. Navy and Coast Guard, February to August 1986

fields.label: PAYLOAD
fields.value: TDRS-B (TDRS-2) with Inertial Upper Stage; SPARTAN-203 Halley's Comet experiment; Teacher in Space Project

missions.title: LightSail 2
missions.subtitle: The Planetary Society / Falcon Heavy STP-2

fields.label: VEHICLE
fields.value: SpaceX Falcon Heavy (STP-2); side boosters B1052 and B1053 (flight 2 each), center core B1057 (flight 1, not recovered)

fields.label: RECOVERY
fields.value: Side boosters landed at LZ-1 (B1052) and LZ-2 (B1053); center core B1057 lost during drone ship landing attempt on Of Course I Still Love You

fields.label: PAYLOAD
fields.value: LightSail 2 solar sail CubeSat, deployed from the Georgia Tech Prox-1 satellite; 24 spacecraft total on STP-2, including COSMIC-2, GPIM and the Deep Space Atomic Clock
